items.headline: [New discussion of Hosea 6:7 and the meaning of the covenant reference](https://heidelblog.net/2026/09/on-hosea-67-and-the-covenant-of-works/)
items.summary: A new article published today revisits Hosea 6:7 and the interpretive question whether the text means 'like Adam', 'like men', or refers to a place called Adam. It is useful as a current example of how translation, covenant language and textual interpretation continue to shape Hosea scholarship.
items.why_it_matters: Directly relevant to Rukhsar's Hosea research because it shows a live interpretive debate around wording, metaphor and theological reception in Hosea. 🔗 Click the title above to open the source.

items.headline: [New Approaches to Biblical Literary Studies — open call, deadline 30 September 2026](https://www.mdpi.com/journal/humanities/special_issue_flyer_pdf_v2/B3Q652GS13)
items.summary: The Humanities special issue New Approaches to Biblical Literary Studies is currently open for manuscript submissions, with a deadline of 30 September 2026. Its scope includes Bible and literature, scripture, hermeneutics, Jewish–Christian relations, biblical allusion, Tanak, and Old and New Testaments.
items.why_it_matters: Potentially useful for Rukhsar's work on Hosea, metaphor, gender, reception and literary interpretation. 🔗 Click the title above to see the call and submission scope.
items.source: Humanities / MDPI; also listed by Society of Biblical Literature

items.headline: [UEF OCREA conference — minorities, women and identity in religious education](https://sites.uef.fi/ocrea20/conference-programme/)
items.summary: The University of Eastern Finland's OCREA 20th-anniversary conference runs 2–4 September 2026 in Joensuu. The programme includes papers on Roma women in religious education, minority teachers, identity markers and religious educational spaces.
items.why_it_matters: Relevant to Rukhsar's wider profile in theology, education, gender, minority Christianity and contextual/reception-oriented work. 🔗 Click the title above for the UEF conference programme.
